ability.name: Step 7 - Domain Controller Gate
ability.description: Evaluates the gathered service map, identifies any DCs, outputs execution conditions, and writes state variables.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $has_dc = $false; $dc_ip = ""; $base_dn = ""; $dc_hostname = ""; $ldap_files = Get-ChildItem $d -Filter "base_dn_*.txt"; if ($ldap_files.Count -gt 0) { $has_dc = $true; $first_file = $ldap_files[0]; $base_dn = Get-Content $first_file.FullName; if ($first_file.Name -match "base_dn_(.+)\.txt") { $dc_ip = $Matches[1] }; $host_file = "$d\dns_hostname_$dc_ip.txt"; if (Test-Path $host_file) { $dc_hostname = Get-Content $host_file } } else { $services_file = "$d\services.json"; if (Test-Path $services_file) { $services = Get-Content $services_file -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($ip in $services.PSObject.Properties.Name) { $ports = $services.$ip | ForEach-Object { $_.port }; if ($ports -contains 88 -and ($ports -contains 389 -or $ports -contains 445)) { $has_dc = $true; $dc_ip = $ip; break } } } }; if ($has_dc) { Write-Output "network.has_domain_controller=true"; Write-Output "recon.ad_present=true"; Write-Output "network.dc_ip=$dc_ip"; if ($base_dn) { Write-Output "domain.base_dn=$base_dn" }; if ($dc_hostname) { Write-Output "domain.dc_hostname=$dc_hostname" }; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT=ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE=false" } else { Write-Output "network.has_domain_controller=false"; Write-Output "recon.ad_present=false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT=establishing-persistence"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE=true" } } catch { Write-Output "network.has_domain_controller=false"; Write-Output "recon.ad_present=false"; Write-Output "ERROR: step7 failed - $_"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT=establishing-persistence" } | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\dc_gate.txt

rationale: Parses and outputs the decisive routing gate keys to direct Phase B AD enumeration.
